en-US.title: Bawi Shopping
en-US.subtitle: Ethiopian fashion marketplace
en-US.description:
Discover a fresh perspective on fashion with Bawi Shopping. Explore clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, accessories, and Habesha styles from independent sellers. Browse collections and new arrivals, or find what you want in dedicated Women, Men, Girls, Boys, and Baby categories.

Save pieces to your wishlist, build your cart, and view prices in Ethiopian birr. When you're ready to order, the app shows the total and Telebirr transfer instructions. Upload your payment confirmation for review, then follow your order status in the app.

Bawi brings discovery and everyday shopping together in one clean, easy-to-use experience. Sellers can also apply to join, manage products, and track fulfillment from the app.

Available features include product search, saved addresses, order updates, and language choices including English, Amharic, Tigrinya, Afaan Oromo, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese. Product selection and delivery depend on availability in your area.
en-US.promoText: Discover fashion and Habesha styles. Browse Women, Men, Girls, Boys, and Baby collections, save favorites, and shop in ETB.
